headline: Burned-in captions are the single biggest lever in meal prep: videos with them get 4.44× the median views/follower lift of those without (n=25).
moves: Add burned-in captions to every meal prep video this week — they carry a 4.44× lift (n=25) and appear in 41% of top-quartile videos vs 23% of bottom-quartile.
Keep videos in the 30–60s window — that format shows a 4.11× lift (n=36) and makes up 45% of the top quartile vs 32% of the bottom.
Go text-heavy on screen — text-heavy videos deliver a 4.02× lift (n=49) and are in 77% of top-quartile videos vs 55% of bottom-quartile.
avoid: Stop using hands + product shots as your main visual — they underperform at 0.42× lift (n=31) and appear in 50% of bottom-quartile videos vs only 36% of top-quartile.
hooks: I meal prepped five lunches in 40 minutes and none of them taste like leftovers.
Here's the exact container stack that keeps my prepped food fresh past day four.
